14. A function fis continuous on the closed interval [2,5]with f(2) =17 and f(5) =17. Which
of the following additional conditions guarantees that there is a number c in the open interval
(2,5) such that f'(c) =0?
(A) No additional conditions are necessary.
(B) f has a relative extremum on the open interval (2, 5).
(C) f is differentiable on the open interval (2, 5).
(D）
f(x) dx exists.
